Manu Bhaker Named Flag-Bearer for Asian Games 2026 Opening Ceremony

Shooter Manu Bhaker has been selected as India's flag-bearer for the opening ceremony of the Asian Games 2026. Bhaker expressed that the honor is "very heartwarming" and brings back memories of her early sporting days. The Asian Games 2026 are scheduled to be held in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan.
